dashboard.title: Synora 镜像同步
dashboard.description: 镜像同步总览：任务状态、仓库大小、CPU/内存、Worker 占用与上限。启动中与运行中统一显示为同步中。24h 指标使用 increase()，成功率使用 live counter。

targets.expr: max by (exported_job, provider) (synora_job_info{exported_job=~"$job_name"} and on (exported_job) (synora_job_status{exported_job=~"$job_name"} == 3 or synora_job_status{exported_job=~"$job_name"} == 4))

targets.expr: max by (exported_job, worker) ((synora_job_status{exported_job=~"$job_name"} == 6 or synora_job_status{exported_job=~"$job_name"} == 7 or synora_job_status{exported_job=~"$job_name"} == 9 or synora_job_status{exported_job=~"$job_name"} == 10))

max by (exported_job, provider) (synora_job_info{exported_job=~"$job_name"} and on (exported_job) (synora_job_status{exported_job=~"$job_name"} == 6 or synora_job_status{exported_job=~"$job_name"} == 7 or synora_job_status{exported_job=~"$job_name"} == 9 or synora_job_status{exported_job=~"$job_name"} == 10))

max by (exported_job) (last_over_time(synora_job_duration_seconds{exported_job=~"$job_name"}[7d]) and on (exported_job) (synora_job_status{exported_job=~"$job_name"} == 6 or synora_job_status{exported_job=~"$job_name"} == 7 or synora_job_status{exported_job=~"$job_name"} == 9 or synora_job_status{exported_job=~"$job_name"} == 10))

(max by (exported_job) ((synora_job_last_end_timestamp{exported_job=~"$job_name"} > 0) and on (exported_job) (synora_job_status{exported_job=~"$job_name"} == 6 or synora_job_status{exported_job=~"$job_name"} == 7 or synora_job_status{exported_job=~"$job_name"} == 9 or synora_job_status{exported_job=~"$job_name"} == 10))) * 1000
